name: Lone Apocalypse
detailed_description:
Tip: This game is currently in early access, and some features and processes may be incomplete!

Game Features

Survivor of the Frozen Wasteland

In the aftermath of the apocalypse, survival is not a choice—it’s the only instinct left.
For the sake of your family’s survival and a chance at a better life, you were forced to join a military faction in this dying world.
But what should have been a routine mission turned into a nightmare: an ambush, a sudden disaster… and your entire unit was wiped out.

You alone survived.
Now stranded on a remote, icebound island—cut off from all support and rescue—you must rely on the fragmented orders left by your superiors, the few supplies you can scavenge, and your own courage and will.
In this desolate land of snow and steel, you must find resources, endure the merciless weather, avoid deadly threats, and uncover the truth behind the catastrophe.
Ultimately, you must discover the one path to escape this frozen prison.

Features

A Lone Survivor’s Struggle

Face extreme cold, sudden storms, and unseen dangers with no allies by your side.
Every expedition is a life-or-death gamble; every decision could mean survival or doom.

A Fusion of Sci-Fi and Wasteland Atmosphere

Explore abandoned high-tech facilities scattered across the island—weathered research stations, derelict observation towers, and frozen experimental chambers.
Each location could be a shelter, a trap, or the key to the mystery.

RPG Progression and Mission-Driven Gameplay

Gain experience and level up by completing missions, exploring the island, and defeating threats.
Unlock new survival skills and gear upgrades while advancing through main and side quests.

Light Open-World Exploration

Travel through multiple distinct regions, each with unique environments, resources, and secrets.
Choose your route—play it safe or risk everything in high-danger areas for rare rewards.

Dynamic Weather and Extreme Conditions

Blizzards may block your path, freezing nights can kill the unprepared, and certain rare resources only appear under specific environmental conditions.

Mystery and Survival Intertwined

Clues found in documents, abandoned equipment, and mission relics will guide you toward the truth.
Crack the mystery to find your way out.

Your Goal

Survive. Complete your mission. Escape.
The snow hides the truth as well as your tracks.
In this isolated land, you have only yourself to rely on.
The question is—can you make it to the end?

short_description: Lone Apocalypse is an open-world survival game set on a frozen island in the near future. Players build, explore, and survive in extreme conditions while uncovering the truth behind a failed climate weapon. The game combines crafting, survival, and story for an immersive post-apocalyptic experience

English, Simplified Chinese*, Russian
